remarks: This is an exceptional home that combines modern design with luxurious comfort, situated on a peaceful in-town cul-de-sac just steps away from local schools and town amenities. Designed by the renowned Fletcher Development, this recently constructed residence spans over 5,300sf and has been meticulously crafted with attention to both aesthetic and functional details. The home offers four finished floors of open, airy living spaces, each flowing seamlessly into the next. The transitional design includes a contemporary color palette and exquisite materials, with a striking glass and steel staircase that unites all four levels. The heart of the home is its stunning kitchen, designed for both beauty and function. With five ensuite bedrooms, including a sophisticated study with custom-built shelving, this property provides ample space for both work and relaxation. A 1,000-square-foot playroom offers the perfect area for family activities, while a private terrace and a third-floor balcony provide additional outdoor spaces to enjoy the surroundings. Quality is at the forefront, with high-efficiency propane HVAC, an Alaskan Cedar roof with copper gutters, and a 22kw generator. The lovely yard offers space for outdoor activities and is a perfect complement to this exceptional home. It's a home that brings together style, efficiency, and comfort in a fantastic location-ideal for modern living.
